title: veronica cusickii f. allenii
intro: Veronica cusickii f. allenii, commonly known as Western Skullcap, is a perennial herb in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is a medicinal plant traditionally used for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating stress. Western Skullcap is valued for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Western Skullcap include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as modulating the nervous system and protecting against oxidative stress.
